note: Hand-written Grade 3 Core-word content, layered over the draft so it always wins. A word appears here when the course had nothing for it, or had it at the wrong reading level or in the wrong sense. Cast is Grade 3's own: Amal, Nora, Sami, Leo, Mina, Daniel, Teacher Yasmin, Omar, and family. Sentences are capped at 74 characters and 15 words, which is what Grade 3's own authored sets already ask a child to read.

Can you analyse this chart with me?

We analyse our mistakes to learn from them.
Scientists analyse what they see very carefully.

ancient.childMeaning: Very old, belonging to a time long before ours.

An ancient wall still surrounds the old town.

We apply our maths when we go shopping.

Clean water must be available to everybody.

basic.childMeaning: Simple, and the part you learn first.

A basic meal of rice and beans is filling.
Sami wrote a basic plan before he started.

beforehand.childMeaning: Before something happens, and in good time.
practiceSentences: Pack your bag beforehand so you are ready.

We booked the tickets beforehand.

belong.childMeaning: To be a member of a group, or to have a proper place.

Which club do you belong to, Nora?

These shoes belong to Sami.
Every tool has a place where it belongs.

What is hidden beneath that cloth?

Cool water runs beneath the dry sand.

How many bones are in your hand?

Milk helps your bones grow strong.

What caption would you write for this picture?

Each caption sits below its own photograph.

career.childMeaning: The work a person does for many years.

central.childMeaning: In the middle, or the most important part.

Which is the central idea of the poem?

The central room is the largest one.

cheer.childMeaning: To shout happily to show you are pleased or to support someone.

cheerful.childMeaning: Happy and bright in the way you look, speak and act.
